subject: 台灣基督長老教會南神神學院西校舍（1957；2024–2025修復後完整主要外觀近似）
scope: Complete two-storey west school, east ground arcade, central east-west through passage, long single-ridge hipped roof and one-bay north connector cut open at main-hall seam. Excludes main hall, chapel, fountain, garden, modern background buildings, carport and subsurface foundations.
result: All five final render pixels personally examined against source images/plans; corrected entrance/door rhythm now matches the source-bound character. No remaining mandatory principal-form correction. Fine scale, color and individual frame/tile dimensions remain approximations.
source_review_scope: The prior source review personally examined 25 report pages and community-04.jpg. This final pass reopened p065, p432 and community-04.jpg and compared the current model with the already-reviewed roof, plan and section evidence. This is not a claim that all 750 report pages or every original image were inspected.

per_view_findings.previews/front.png: East side has nine upper arches and a ground-level sequence of four round arches, one central flat portal and four round arches. The south end has one upper arch, two lower rectangular windows with a shared canopy, and a true gallery opening. The revised rear-wall arrangement has five doors and eight windows with a gray lower band. The neighboring chapel is excluded.
per_view_findings.previews/rear.png: West side has eight upper arches plus three small northern bathroom windows. Lower rectangular windows are separated by the central through-passage and shallow canopy. The north short end differs from the south end; the D2 connector-to-body door and side panes are visible rather than a blank wall.
per_view_findings.previews/elevation.png: The east arcade has the correct 4 + central + 4 opening pattern, nine upper arches, and the source-based rear-wall door/window grouping rather than one generic item per arch. North connector openings are retained at both levels.
per_view_findings.previews/top.png: The roof has a single long ridge and four hipped slopes, not the main hall's five-roof arrangement. There is no invented skylight or PV array. The short offset connector and display plinth remain within the named scope.
per_view_findings.previews/left_oblique.png: The north connector terminates in an open cut-end, not a false exterior wall. The upper D2 door proxy identifies access to the body. The east gallery and north open arch have readable depth.
per_view_findings.qa/corridor-detail.png: A camera-only view of the uncut mesh from the south gallery mouth shows a continuous open corridor to the far end. Doors and windows are behind the front arcade, not black marks on a solid front wall.
per_view_findings.qa/passage-detail.png: A camera-only view aligned with the central east-west passage shows the opposite outlet. No concealed cuts or hidden geometry were used.

corrections_closed.issue: The north second-floor connector-to-body junction lacked a door and side panes.
corrections_closed.resolution: The D2 door and adjacent panes on source pages 432 and 436 are now represented by visible, opaque miniature proxies. The interior beyond the door remains simplified; a complete internal corridor is not claimed.

corrections_closed.issue: The east arcade rear wall had a generic four-door, four-window arrangement.
corrections_closed.resolution: Changed to three doors and five windows south of the central passage and two doors and three windows north of it, with pale frames and divided dark doors. Positions are estimated from the formal plan and corroborating photographs. The gray lower-wall band is segmented so the central passage remains open.

corrections_closed.issue: Generator inherited NPUST Second Refectory comment/docstring
corrections_closed.resolution: Identity corrected to TTCS west school; the final generator is bound by hash. There are no model-scope changes or new source assumptions.

independent_technical_summary.method: Reviewer-owned Python reads the raw STL directly and checks exact-coordinate welding, oriented edge pairs, positive volume, absence of zero-area or duplicate triangles, connected vertex-surface components, and stored normals. It parses raw 3MF XML and mesh.json to compare every triangle coordinate, order and winding, and all eight palette assignments. No mesh healing or builder classifier was used.
independent_technical_summary.probe_scope: Thirty-seven builder-located points were independently recomputed using non-axis-aligned Moller-Trumbore parity, plus five reviewer-chosen points. Locations are model/source proportional coordinates, not independent survey measurements.
independent_technical_summary.clear_segment_scope: Actual raw-STL triangle intersections along the central passage, south-to-north gallery, and north open upper terminal are all zero within the requested ranges.
independent_technical_summary.limits: No independent exhaustive wall-thickness, vertex-link or self-intersection proof, physical print, or toolpath test was performed. Builder lib3mf/Blend edit-save-reopen and clean-rebuild evidence was inspected and exact hashes were checked, but these operations were not independently rerun here.

manufacturing_and_representation_limits: All 290 horizontal layers are valid, but 205 layers contain actual islands that fail the 0.8 mm erosion test, mostly from 0.715 mm downpipe segments. These failures remain disclosed; they are not exempted or represented as a minimum-wall-thickness pass.

Grilles are approximately 0.33 mm, downpipes 0.715 mm, and tile courses 0.3025 mm. These are fine miniature details. Arches, connector beams, canopies and eaves require slicer, orientation and support planning. There is no successful physical-print or support-free guarantee.

The nominal 63.25 × 200.75 × 57.982 mm dimensions include the display base and are approximate, not dimensioned as-built measurements. Fine window/door frames, tile counts, iron bars and apparatus may be simplified.
Only eight opaque materials are used. Glass and door proxies are opaque solids in all formats. The actual arcade, central passage and short-connector voids are geometry, not alpha or image effects.

The controlling official report was issued in June 2025 and concerns the 1957 building. Photograph captions provide dates in 2024–2025. The community photograph has EXIF 2026-04-03 without a time-zone offset; it corroborates only the interface, not complete 2026 conditions.

The roof represents weathered gray/gray-brown cement tiles, not the main hall's red tiles. Source photographs and the PDF are excluded from the public package. The CC BY license applies only to the original generated parts.
binding_and_release: This review binds the named local frozen core, PNGs and current QA/documents. The reviewer has not edited or published the main repository. Actual final ZIP member/checksum validation remains a separate awaited step. Any changed bound core or image requires renewed review; navigation-only README updates require a narrowly scoped hash update.

navigation_only_rebind.scope: Only a trailing navigation heading and three relative README links were added. Original README text is an exact prefix; all 12 frozen core files, five PNGs, supplementary images, technical checks and other bound QA/documents are unchanged. No geometry re-review was required. Final ZIP closure must be repeated after repacking.
